scenes.text: Imagine sitting inside a heavily insulated room so incredibly quiet that you can actually hear your own lungs scraping against your ribs and the warm blood rushing through your veins.
This is the famous anechoic chamber in Minnesota, officially documented as one of the quietest places on Earth, where the massive heavy concrete walls seal out every single external sound instantly.

Within minutes, your ears desperately adapt to the absolute dead silence, causing you to hear your heartbeat echoing like a drum and completely losing your physical balance as you start to hallucinate.
No one has ever survived alone in this dark chamber for more than forty-five minutes before begging to get out, so would you dare to try it and follow me for more?
